source_text: Die Sicherungsmutter M-12 der Halterung BR-7 mit einem 13-mm-Maulschlüssel lösen. Die Mutter nicht wiederverwenden. Eine neue Mutter einbauen und mit 9 N·m anziehen.
reference:
Loosen self-locking nut M-12 on bracket BR-7 with a 13 mm wrench.
Do not use the nut again.
Install a new nut.
Tighten the nut to 9 N·m.

source_text: VORSICHT: Die Flachdichtung zwischen den Flanschen F-3 und F-4 nicht mit einem Schraubendreher entfernen. Die Flanschflächen können beschädigt werden. Die Dichtung mit einem Kunststoffschaber entfernen.
reference:
CAUTION: Do not use a screwdriver to remove the gasket between flanges F-3 and F-4. You can cause damage to the flange surfaces.
Use a plastic scraper to remove the gasket.

source_text: Den Stecker P-22 vom Sensor TS-31 lösen. Den Schlüssel des Wartungsschranks MC-2 erst nach Abschluss der Arbeiten zurückgeben.
reference:
Disconnect connector P-22 from sensor TS-31.
Return the key of maintenance cabinet MC-2 only after you complete the work.

source_text: WARNUNG: Die Hydraulikleitung HL-9 niemals unter Druck öffnen. Vor dem Öffnen den Druck auf 0 bar ablassen.
reference:
WARNING: Never open hydraulic line HL-9 when it is under pressure.
Before you open the line, release the pressure to 0 bar.

source_text: HINWEIS: Die Druckluft für die Reinigung darf höchstens 2 bar betragen. VORSICHT: Den Druckluftstrahl nicht direkt auf die Membran des Sensors DS-5 richten.
reference:
NOTE: The compressed air for cleaning must be a maximum of 2 bar.
CAUTION: Do not point the compressed air directly at the diaphragm of sensor DS-5.

source_text: Den Deckel C-8 nur öffnen, wenn die Batterie BAT-6 abgeklemmt ist. Während der Arbeit keine Werkzeuge auf der Batterie ablegen.
reference:
Open cover C-8 only when battery BAT-6 is disconnected.
Do not put tools on the battery during the work.

source_text:
Bauteil: Kraftstoffleitung FL-14
Anschluss: Überwurfmutter, 18 N·m
Werkzeug: Drehmomentschlüssel
Bedingung: nur bei ausgeschalteter Kraftstoffpumpe
Sicherheit: VORSICHT - Leitung nicht verbiegen
reference:
CAUTION: Do not bend fuel line FL-14.
Make sure that the fuel pump is off.
Tighten the nut on fuel line FL-14 to 18 N·m with a torque wrench.

source_text: AVERTISSEMENT : Ne jamais toucher les bornes de la batterie BT-3 à mains nues. Porter des gants isolants de classe 0.
reference:
WARNING: Never touch the terminals of battery BT-3 with bare hands.
Wear insulating gloves of class 0.

source_text: Desserrer l'écrou E-5 de deux tours. Ne pas déposer l'écrou. Serrer ensuite l'écrou à 6 N·m.
reference:
Loosen nut E-5 two turns.
Do not remove the nut.
Then tighten the nut to 6 N·m.

source_text: ATTENTION : Ne pas utiliser de solvant sur le joint torique JT-12. REMARQUE : Le joint torique peut être réutilisé s'il n'est pas endommagé.
reference:
CAUTION: Do not use solvent on O-ring JT-12.
NOTE: You can use the O-ring again if it has no damage.

source_text: Ne jamais débrancher le connecteur CN-40 tant que le disjoncteur CB-12 est fermé.
reference: Never disconnect connector CN-40 while circuit breaker CB-12 is closed.

source_text: Déposer le panneau d'accès PA-21 uniquement après la mise hors tension du bus DC-3. Si le voyant L-2 reste allumé, ne pas continuer.
reference:
Remove access panel PA-21 only after you de-energize bus DC-3.
If light L-2 stays on, do not continue.

source_text:
Composant : vis de fixation VF-6
Quantité : 4
Couple : 2,5 N·m
Outil : clé dynamométrique
Sécurité : ATTENTION - ne pas dépasser le couple
reference:
CAUTION: Do not torque the screws to more than the specified value.
Tighten the 4 mounting screws VF-6 to 2.5 N·m with a torque wrench.

source_text: Scoateți cele 6 șuruburi ale panoului de acces 45B. Nu pierdeți șaibele.
reference:
Remove the 6 screws of access panel 45B.
Do not lose the washers.

source_text: Strângeți piulița P-17 la 11 N·m cu o cheie dinamometrică. Nu folosiți o cheie cu clichet.
reference:
Tighten nut P-17 to 11 N·m with a torque wrench.
Do not use a ratchet wrench.

source_text: ATENȚIE: Nu curățați garnitura G-3 cu solvent. NOTĂ: Garnitura se poate refolosi dacă nu are fisuri.
reference:
CAUTION: Do not clean seal G-3 with solvent.
NOTE: You can use the seal again if it has no cracks.

source_text: AVERTISMENT: Nu deschideți niciodată capacul C-9 în timp ce motorul funcționează. Așteptați cel puțin 15 minute după oprirea motorului.
reference:
WARNING: Never open cover C-9 while the engine operates.
Wait a minimum of 15 minutes after the engine stops.

source_text: Deconectați conectorul J-14 numai dacă întrerupătorul CB-8 este deschis. Dacă indicatorul I-2 este roșu, nu continuați lucrul.
reference:
Disconnect connector J-14 only if circuit breaker CB-8 is open.
If indicator I-2 is red, do not continue the work.

source_text:
Componentă: panou de acces 22R
Acțiune: montați panoul
Șuruburi: 8, cuplu 3 N·m
Condiție: numai după oprirea alimentării electrice
Siguranță: AVERTISMENT - tensiune 115 V
reference:
WARNING: There is 115 V in this area.
Make sure that the electrical power is off.
Install access panel 22R.
Tighten the 8 screws to 3 N·m.

source_text: You shouldn't ever disconnect the oxygen line OX-3 unless the shutoff valve SV-2 has been fully closed first, and the area must be kept free of oil or grease while the work is being done.
reference:
Do not disconnect oxygen line OX-3 unless shutoff valve SV-2 is fully closed.
Keep the area free of oil and grease during the work.

source_text: CAUTION: The sealant must not be applied when the temperature is below 10 °C, because it will not cure properly. NOTE: The sealant cures in about 24 hours.
reference:
CAUTION: Do not apply the sealant when the temperature is less than 10 °C. The sealant will not cure correctly.
NOTE: The sealant cures in approximately 24 hours.

source_text: After the actuator ACT-5 has been installed and only when the hydraulic system has been depressurized, the rod end should be connected, and it is important that the cotter pin is not reused.
reference:
Install actuator ACT-5.
Make sure that the hydraulic system is depressurized.
Then connect the rod end.
Do not use the cotter pin again.

source_text: Do not stand in front of the propeller while the ignition switch IS-1 is on, and never turn the propeller by hand unless the magnetos have been grounded.
reference:
Do not stand in front of the propeller while ignition switch IS-1 is on.
Never turn the propeller by hand unless the magnetos are grounded.

source_text:
CAUTION: Do not use a metal tool on the seal.
Remove seal S-14 with a plastic tool.
Discard the seal.
reference:
CAUTION: Do not use a metal tool on the seal.
Remove seal S-14 with a plastic tool.
Discard the seal.

source_text:
WARNING: Hydraulic fluid is poisonous. Put on gloves and goggles.
1. Release the pressure to 0 psi.
2. Disconnect line HL-6.
3. Put a cap on the line.
reference:
WARNING: Hydraulic fluid is poisonous. Put on gloves and goggles.
1. Release the pressure to 0 psi.
2. Disconnect line HL-6.
3. Put a cap on the line.

source_text:
NOTE: The torque value includes the lubricant.
Tighten bolt B-21 to 32 N·m.
reference:
NOTE: The torque value includes the lubricant.
Tighten bolt B-21 to 32 N·m.

source_text:
If the indicator is red, do not start the engine.
Replace filter element FE-3.
reference:
If the indicator is red, do not start the engine.
Replace filter element FE-3.
